subject: Notifications not going through
body:
Hello,
 
I am currently using Avicenna for my research project (ID: 4055). One of the participants told me that they have not received notifications to complete surveys. Do you know how I might be able to fix this so that the participant can indeed receive the notifications to complete surveys?
 
Thanks,
Ximena
 
 

​​___

Ximena Giesemann, M.A. (she/her)

Doctoral Candidate | Positive Developmental Psychology

Well-Being & Developmental Methods Research Lab

Claremont Graduate University


I honor and respect boundaries around personal time, well-being, care-taking, and rest. If you receive this message while engaged in any of these things, please take that time for yourself and respond when you can.

Hi Ximen,
This is Amin from Avicenna.
That's unfortunate to hear, but we're here to help you with the issue. Can you please provide us with more information? The following information will be helpful:
1- Your participant's phone model
2- Whether you set custom activities or notifications for the that specific participant?
3-The study ID and the participant's ID
I'll look forward to the info.
Best,
Amin
